media.alt: A 68 second video. Owner Justin Myrick walks along the old service counter of the empty former DMV in Orange Park. The shot softly dissolves into the full guided tour of the Fore Motion Golf 3D concept from the website, labeled Concept throughout: from above the building down to the front entrance, in through the door to the bar, around the central putting green and into one of the four simulator bays, then rising back out over the venue. On-screen text: Owner Justin Myrick walks the space. The concept, start to finish. It ends on Join the Founders List, Opening early 2027, 1518 Park Ave, Orange Park, FL, and foremotiongolf.com. The logo is at the top and foremotiongolf.com at the foot throughout.

Owner Justin Myrick in a mint polo walks away down the long, tiled counter area of the empty former DMV, under a deep green top band with the Fore Motion Golf logo and the line Owner Justin Myrick walks the space, with foremotiongolf.com at the foot.
